scope: valid_compose_new strict-success reviewer pool through the first reviewed Batch37 success

rules.intentional_articulation: A requested drawer close must be a deliberate interaction with that drawer. Contact with another drawer that incidentally closes the requested drawer is invalid.
rules.close_initialization: Every requested drawer-close target must start fully open, comfortably beyond the native open threshold; dead-band or slightly-open initialization is prohibited.
rules.semantic_redundancy: Keep the strongest representative of one pattern and reject weaker object substitutions or copies of LIBERO-10 patterns.
rules.downstream_preservation: A later subtask must not knock over, displace, or otherwise invalidate an object placement produced by an earlier subtask, even when the final native predicates remain true.
